# HazardNet

HazardNet is a public multi-hazard early-warning service for Bangladesh agriculture. It publishes continuous 15-day daily outlooks for all 64 districts of Bangladesh across 8 hazards (cold wave, drought, fire, flash flood, flood, heat wave, severe local storm, tropical cyclone), with continuous severity scoring, district-level advisories, and full provenance for every published number.

HazardNet is not an official warning service. For emergencies, follow the Bangladesh Meteorological Department and national disaster-management bulletins.

## Key pages

- Live map and forecasts: https://www.hazardnet.live/live
- Alerts: https://www.hazardnet.live/alerts
- Daily advisories by sector: https://www.hazardnet.live/advisories
- Daily reports (auto-published from the verified Kaggle dataset): https://www.hazardnet.live/reports
- Daily report archive: https://www.hazardnet.live/reports/archive
- District pages: https://www.hazardnet.live/districts
- Hazard methodology: https://www.hazardnet.live/hazards
- Model card and known limitations: https://www.hazardnet.live/model
- Methodology: https://www.hazardnet.live/methodology
- Data sources: https://www.hazardnet.live/data-sources
- FAQ: https://www.hazardnet.live/faq
- System status and data freshness: https://www.hazardnet.live/status

## Data provenance

Daily advisories are published by an automated pipeline from a versioned Kaggle dataset (ashifahmedshuvo/hazardnet-weekly-forecasts). Every published snapshot records the dataset version, run id, generation time, and input SHA-256. The machine-readable snapshot is served at https://www.hazardnet.live/data/daily-advisories-v1.json and the alert artifact at https://www.hazardnet.live/data/alerts-latest.json.

## For agents

- robots.txt: https://www.hazardnet.live/robots.txt (search discovery allowed; AI training and AI-input uses are opted out via Content-Signal)
- Sitemap: https://www.hazardnet.live/sitemap.xml
- All public pages are prerendered to static HTML; no JavaScript is required to read content.
